reason: Bridges DSH sessions with WeChat for remote task monitoring, approval responses, and text injection, with persistent deduplication and message buffering.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH 会话连接到微信，用于远程接收任务状态和审批通知、回复审批并注入文本指令。
summaries.en: Connects DSH sessions to WeChat for remote task updates, approval responses, and text command injection.

capabilities: connects DSH to the WeChat iLink channel
pushes turn completion, error, blocked-state, and approval notifications
injects WeChat text into a bound DSH session
persists message deduplication and buffered-input state
